source.title: Collaboration between the WCA and Guinness World Records
source.content:
Dear Community,

The WCA has recently partnered with Guinness World Records (GWR) in order to acknowledge WCA World Records as Guinness World Records! You can see the page for cubing records on the GWR website [here](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/products/books/guinness-world-records-2020/viralsports/cubing) and the page of the partnership with the WCA [here](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/about-us/partners/organisations/world-cube-association). 

When a new WR happens, the WCA Communication Team will contact the record breaker for them to obtain an official certificate and the GWR website will be updated.

We are really happy about this collaboration and look forward to the many records that will be broken in the future!

translation.title: WCA 与吉尼斯世界纪录达成合作
translation.content:
亲爱的社区成员：

WCA 近期与吉尼斯世界纪录（GWR）建立合作，WCA 世界纪录将获得吉尼斯世界纪录的认可！你可以在[这里](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/products/books/guinness-world-records-2020/viralsports/cubing)查看吉尼斯官网的魔方纪录页面，也可以在[这里](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/about-us/partners/organisations/world-cube-association)查看双方合作介绍。

出现新的世界纪录时，WCA 通讯组将联系破纪录者，协助其取得官方证书，吉尼斯官网也会相应更新。

我们很高兴达成这项合作，期待未来更多纪录被打破！
